transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I need to finalize the manifest and dispatch instruction for today's single lift, so let's get the distribution sync going. We've got four cargo lots to move without splitting any lot: Medical, Repair Parts, Water, and Signal Batteries. Truck 1 and Truck 2 are both rated at 8 pallets each, giving us 16 pallets total capacity. The standard manifest shows 4 pallets of Repair Parts, 5 pallets of Water, and 2 pallets of Signal Batteries. I still need the Medical lot quantity from the warehouse release. Both trucks depart through the East Gate, earliest dispatch at 0800. Before I sign off, I need each of you to report any current changes or issues. Warehouse lead, can you confirm the Medical pallet count on the release? Motor pool, any changes to truck availability or capacity? Signal, anything affecting the battery shipment? Gate control, any restrictions at East Gate this morning?
